html:
Well, I just returned from my 30th reunion at West Point this weekend and both Carol and I had a wonderful time. I was proud to be able to shake the hands of those wonderful young men and women, America’s sons and daughters, and know that they are our country’s future leaders. Walking around the West Point grounds with the fall leaves sparkling in the fall sunshine, it was easy to see why Forbes Magazine rated West Point as this year’s #1 college in America.

Anyway, it was great fun connecting with old friends and classmates and getting a chance to see what everyone was up to these days.
